subject: general
question: Harjeet bought a second-hand scooter for ₹18,000 and spent ₹8,000 for repairing it. At what price should he sell the scooter to get a profit of 10%?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Cost Price = Base Price + Repair Cost = 18000 + 8000 = ₹26,000

To gain a 10% profit, the selling price will be 110% of the Total Cost Price.

⇒ Selling Price = 26000 × 1.10 = ₹28,600

**∴ The correct answer is ₹28,600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Purchase price of the second-hand scooter = ₹18,000

Money spent on repairing the scooter = ₹8,000

Desired profit percentage = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Total Cost Price (CP) = Purchase Price + Overhead Charges

Selling Price (SP) = Total CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100
